# gcore_cdn_certificates (Data Source)

CDN SSL certificates enable HTTPS content delivery, supporting both uploaded certificates and automated Let's Encrypt provisioning.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cdn_certificates" "example_cdn_certificates" {
  automated = true
  resource_id = 0
  validity_not_after_lte = "validity_not_after_lte"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `automated` (Boolean) How the SSL certificate was issued.

Possible values:
- **true** – Certificate was issued automatically.
- **false** – Certificate was added by a user.
- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `resource_id` (Number) CDN resource ID for which certificates are requested.
- `validity_not_after_lte` (String) Date and time when the certificate become untrusted (ISO 8601/RFC 3339 format, UTC.)

Response will contain only certificates valid until the specified time.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `automated` (Boolean) How the SSL certificate was issued.

Possible values:
- **true** - Certificate was issued automatically.
- **false** - Certificate was added by a use.
- `cert_issuer` (String) Name of the certification center issued the SSL certificate.
- `cert_subject_alt` (String) Alternative domain names that the SSL certificate secures.
- `cert_subject_cn` (String) Domain name that the SSL certificate secures.
- `deleted` (Boolean) Defines whether the certificate has been deleted. Parameter is **deprecated**.

Possible values:
- **true** - Certificate has been deleted.
- **false** - Certificate has not been deleted.
- `has_related_resources` (Boolean) Defines whether the SSL certificate is used by a CDN resource.

Possible values:
- **true** - Certificate is used by a CDN resource.
- **false** - Certificate is not used by a CDN resource.
- `id` (Number) SSL certificate ID.
- `name` (String) SSL certificate name.
- `ssl_certificate_chain` (String) Parameter is **deprecated**.
- `validity_not_after` (String) Date when certificate become untrusted (ISO 8601/RFC 3339 format, UTC.)
- `validity_not_before` (String) Date when certificate become valid (ISO 8601/RFC 3339 format, UTC.)
